The BUSINESS additionally needs a PMSB Contractor License (master of record, § 105.18(2)(d); $500,000 public liability insurance + $5,000 bond, each with 10-day cancellation notice, per DIAL contractor-license page; + 91C registration). Individuals: master/journeyperson structure with apprentice (USDOL-registered program) and unlicensed helper tier (§ 105.11(7)). Homeowner exemption: own principal residence only, existing dwelling not larger than single-family, which 'shall qualify for the homestead tax credit' (§ 105.11(3), Iowa Code 2026); NO small-town exemption exists in ch. 105. Unlicensed practice draws civil penalties (§ 105.27; 481 IAC 434.5)
